Senior SQL Server Database Administrator
description:
Role Overview
 



  





 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SQL Server DBA to manage and support enterprise database platforms across on\-premise and multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). The role is primarily centered around Microsoft SQL Server, while also requiring strong hands\-on experience in PostgreSQL and exposure to modern cloud\-native database services.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should operate as a cross\-skilled senior DBA, capable of working across multiple database technologies, supporting both SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments in production, and contributing to cloud\-native database operations. The role demands strong ownership of critical systems, along with the ability to adapt to evolving database platforms across relational and non\-relational ecosystems.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. SQL Server Administration \& Production Operations
 



 2\. Multi\-Cloud \& Managed Database Operations
 



 3\. Cross\-Skilled Database Operations (SQL \+ PostgreSQL \+ Cloud DBs)
 



 4\. Database Migration \& Modernization Support
 



 5\. Production Support \& Reliability
 



  





  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



  




* 8–10\+ years of strong SQL Server DBA experience
* Min 6\+ years of hands\-on working experience with PostgreSQL
* Proven expertise in performance tuning, HA/DR, and production system management
* Min 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Azure SQL, AWS RDS, or other managed database platforms
* Exposure to MySQL / MariaDB and modern cloud\-native databases
* Strong troubleshooting, performance tuning, and scripting skills



  





 Automation \& DevOps Alignment
 



  





 • Support automation of database provisioning, monitoring, and maintenance tasks
 



 • Work with DevOps teams to integrate database operations within CI/CD pipelines
 



 • Use scripting (PowerShell, Python) for operational efficiency
 



 • Contribute to improving DBA processes through automation and standardization
 



 Professional Expectations
 



  





 • Strong ownership mindset for critical production systems
 



 • Ability to work across multiple database technologies and cloud environments
 



 • Effective collaboration with application, cloud, and DevOps teams
 



 • Team Player with a go getter mindset to contribute to project and practice initiatives
 



 • Clear communication during escalations, incidents, and production issues

title: Tech S And T - Manager Resilience DB - GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description: Resilience Manager\- DB**
**Experience Range:** 
 12\-15 years \|
 **Role Level:** 
 Manager
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Lead enterprise database resilience and recovery programs across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate, Data Specialist - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work\-guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Associate, Data Specialist sits within the Data Foundation \& Governance pillar of the Global People Data Analytics \& Reporting (PDAR) function. This role is responsible for establishing and maintaining trusted people\-data foundations — standardized definitions, a business glossary, and data quality — across Workday and connected HR systems. The Associate will support master data governance, data alignment, and documentation that underpin consistent, reliable reporting and analytics for the global workforce
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Develop and maintain standardized HR data definitions and a business / metric glossary across HR, Finance, and business units
* Establish and run data quality standards, checks, and periodic audits to ensure accuracy and consistency
* Support data alignment across Workday, Jobvite and other people systems
* Maintain master data governance for key entities such as positions, organizations, and cost centers
* Document data lineage, definitions, and change controls to preserve consistency over time
* Partner with HRIS on Workday data architecture and configuration decisions that impact reporting
* Support governance and stewardship processes, including definition change requests and dispute resolution
* Identify and remediate data quality issues in partnership with reporting and HRIS teams
* Contribute to audit and compliance reporting, ensuring adherence to data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR)
* Help prepare the data foundation for future migration to a governed data lakehouse


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Management, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in data management, data governance, or HR data / reporting
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, and master data management principles
* Familiarity with Workday data structures; exposure to Jobvite or similar HR systems a plus
* Proficiency in Excel and data analysis; exposure to Alteryx preferred
* Strong attention to detail with a methodical, quality\-focused approach to data
* Understanding of HR data domains (positions, org structures, cost centers, headcount)
* Good communication skills and the ability to document standards clearly
* Awareness of data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and secure data handling
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional environment


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
